daily_update: Reported US political, election and issue-ad spend on Facebook was $10,751,964 on Oct. 23, up $588,131 (5.8%) from Oct. 22.
methodology: Digital Politics automatically collects Meta’s public United States ‘Last day’ Ad Library report and retains each raw report privately. The cumulative figure begins with the 90-day baseline ending Sept 20, 2026, then adds subsequent daily reports. Figures cover political, election and issue ads delivered via Facebook in the United States, including Washington, DC, but excluding territories and Meta’s ‘Unknown’ location. State delivery does not establish congressional-district targeting, campaign coordination or electoral effect.
